nodes.name: Comics
nodes.description: Sequential art combining images and text to narrate stories.

nodes.name: Comic Strip
nodes.description: Short multi-panel comics published in newspapers, often humorous.

nodes.name: Comic Book
nodes.description: Periodical publication of serialized comics in stapled or bound form.

nodes.name: Superhero Comics
nodes.description: Comics centered on costumed heroes with extraordinary powers.

nodes.name: Graphic Novel
nodes.description: Book-length comics with a complete narrative arc.

nodes.name: Graphic Memoir
nodes.description: Autobiographical comics in book form.

nodes.name: Alternative Comics
nodes.description: Independent, artist-driven comics outside mainstream genres.

nodes.name: Editorial Cartoon
nodes.description: Single-panel satirical cartoon commenting on politics and society.

nodes.name: Comics Anthology
nodes.description: A collection of short comics by multiple creators.

nodes.name: Webcomic
nodes.description: Comics published serially on the internet.

nodes.name: Webtoon
nodes.description: Korean-style digital comics formatted for vertical scrolling on phones.

nodes.name: Manga
nodes.description: Japanese comics spanning a vast range of genres and demographics.

nodes.name: Shonen Manga
nodes.description: Manga aimed at young male readers, emphasizing action and adventure.

nodes.name: Shojo Manga
nodes.description: Manga aimed at young female readers, emphasizing romance and relationships.

nodes.name: Seinen Manga
nodes.description: Manga for adult men with mature and sophisticated themes.

nodes.name: Josei Manga
nodes.description: Manga for adult women depicting realistic relationships.

nodes.name: Gekiga
nodes.description: Dramatic, realistic manga for adults that emerged in the 1950s.

nodes.name: Yonkoma
nodes.description: Four-panel gag manga format.

nodes.name: Doujinshi
nodes.description: Self-published or amateur manga, often fan-made.

nodes.name: Manhwa
nodes.description: Korean comics, historically in print and now prominent as webtoons.

nodes.name: Manhua
nodes.description: Chinese comics spanning print and digital formats.

nodes.name: Bande Dessinée
nodes.description: Franco-Belgian comics tradition of long-form albums.
